table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname=MAX(I.Name),
	Categoryname=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=MAX(I.icatcode)),
	openingstock= SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'OPEN'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) ,
	purqty= SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'PUR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) ,
	purval= SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'PUR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) * (I.purprice/(CASE I.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.packunits END)),
	prqty= SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'PR'THEN A.qty  ELSE 0 END),
	prvalue= SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'PR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)* (I.purprice/(CASE I.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.packunits END)),
	saleqty= SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'S'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'DS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END),
	srqty= SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'SR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END),
	netsaleqty= SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'S'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'DS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) -  SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'SR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END),
	netsaleval=( SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'S'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'DS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'SR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END))* (I.SalePrice/(CASE I.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.packunits END )),
	cgs=( SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'S'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'DS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)- SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'SR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END))* (I.Purprice/(CASE I.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.packunits END )),
	grossprofit=(( SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'S'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)  + SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'DS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'SR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END))
			* (I.SalePrice/(CASE I.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.packunits END )))
			- (( SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'S'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'DS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)) - SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'SR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END))*I.avgprice,
	adj=SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'ADJ'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) ,
	cstock=SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'OPEN'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		+ SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'PUR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		- SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'PR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		- SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'S'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		- SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'DS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		+ SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'SR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		+ SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'ADJ'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) 
		+ SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'RECPT'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) 
		- SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'IS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) 
		- SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'PENDINGDUE'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) ,

	cstockvalpur=(SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'OPEN'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		+ SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'PUR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		- SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'PR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		- SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'S'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		- SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'DS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		+ SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'SR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		+ SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'ADJ'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) 
		+ SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'RECPT'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) 
		- SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'IS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) 
		- SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'PENDINGDUE'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) ) *  (I.purprice/(CASE I.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.packunits END)),
	cstockvalsale=(SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'OPEN'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		+ SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'PUR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		- SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'PR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		- SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'S'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		- SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'DS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		+ SUM(CASE A.type WHEN 'SR'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END)
		+ SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'ADJ'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) 
		+ SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'RECPT'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) 
		- SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'IS'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) 
		- SUM( CASE A.type WHEN 'PENDINGDUE'THEN A.qty ELSE 0 END) ) *  (I.Saleprice/(CASE I.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE I.packunits END))
	
	

FROM  (select 	icode=pd.icode,
			type='PUR',
			qty=( sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
							when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
							when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
							else pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty end, 0)))
			from purdetail pd ,purledger pl
			where pl.postdate>=:ar_StartDate and pl.postdate<=:ar_EndDate and
				pl.purinvcode=pd.purinvcode and
				pl.posted='Y' and
				pd.icode IN (select icode from item where icatcode IN (:ar_catcode) and active=1)
			group by pd.icode
	
			UNION All
			
			select 	icode=pd.icode,
				type='PR',
				qty=( sum(isnull(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty, 0)))
			from prdetail pd ,prledger pl
			where pl.date>=:ar_StartDate and pl.date<=:ar_EndDate and
				pl.prinvcode=pd.prinvcode and
				pd.icode IN (select icode from item where icatcode IN (:ar_catcode) and active=1)
			group by pd.icode
			
			UNION All
			
			select 	icode=pd.icode,
				type='S',
				qty=( sum(isnull(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty, 0)))
			from saledetail pd ,saleledger pl
			where pl.date>=:ar_StartDate and pl.date<=:ar_EndDate and
				pl.saleinvcode=pd.saleinvcode and
				pd.due is Null and
				pd.icode IN (select icode from item where icatcode IN (:ar_catcode) and active=1)
			group by pd.icode
			
			UNION ALL
		
			select 	icode=pd.icode,
				type='DS',
				qty=( sum(isnull(pd.duesatisfyqty, 0)))
			from duesatisfydetail pd ,duesatisfyheader pl
			where pl.duesatisfydate>=:ar_StartDate and pl.duesatisfydate<=:ar_EndDate and
				pl.duesatisfycode=pd.duesatisfycode and
				pd.icode IN (select icode from item where icatcode IN (:ar_catcode) and active=1)
			group by pd.icode
			
			UNION All
			
			select 	icode=pd.icode,
				type='SR',
				qty=( sum(isnull(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty, 0)))
			from srdetail pd ,srledger pl
			where pl.postdate>=:ar_StartDate and pl.postdate<=:ar_EndDate and
				pl.srinvcode=pd.srinvcode and
				pd.icode IN (select icode from item where icatcode IN (:ar_catcode) and active=1)
			group by pd.icode
		
			UNION ALL
		
			select icode=pd.icode,
				type='ADJ',
				qty= ISNULL(sum(Case when pl.adjcatcode=1 
							then    pd.looseqty 
							ELSE    (-1) * pd.looseqty
							END ),0)
					from adjdetail pd ,adjheader pl
					where pl.date >=:ar_StartDate and pl.date<=:ar_EndDate  and
					 pl.adjcode=pd.adjcode and
					 pd.icode IN (select icode from item where icatcode IN (:ar_catcode) and active=1)
			group by
				pd.icode
		
			UNION ALL
		
			select icode=pd.icode,
				type='IS',
				qty= ISNULL(sum(pd.qty),0)
			from issuedetail pd, issueheader pl
			where pl.date>=:ar_startdate and pl.date<=:ar_EndDate and
				pl.issueinvcode=pd.issueinvcode and
				pd.icode IN (select icode from item where icatcode IN (:ar_catcode) and active=1)
			group by
				pd.icode
		
			UNION ALL
		
			select icode=pd.icode,
				type='RECPT',
				qty= ISNULL(sum(pd.qty),0)
			from receiptdetail pd, receiptheader pl
			where pl.postdate>=:ar_startdate and pl.postdate<=:ar_EndDate and
				pl.posted='Y' and
				pl.receiptinvcode=pd.receiptinvcode and
				pd.icode IN (select icode from item where icatcode IN (:ar_catcode) and active=1)
			group by
				pd.icode
			
			UNION ALL
		
			select	icode= item.icode,
				type='PENDINGDUE',
				DueQty = (select isnull(sum(SD.looseqty+SD.bonusqty),0) from saledetail SD where SD.Due IN ('X','D','S') and SD.icode=item.Icode)
						- (select isnull(sum(DD.DeletedQty),0) from DueDeleteDetail DD where DD.icode=item.ICode)
						- (select isnull(sum(DS.DueSatisfyQty),0) from duesatisfydetail DS where DS.icode=item.icode)
			from item
			where item.icatcode IN (:ar_catcode) and item.active=1
			group by item.icode

			UNION ALL
			
			select icode=item.icode,
				type='OPEN',
				opening=(SELECT ISNULL(sum(B.qty),0)
								 FROM
									(select qty=( sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
														when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
														when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
														else pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty end, 0)))
									from purdetail pd ,purledger pl
									where  pl.postdate<:ar_StartDate and
										pl.purinvcode=pd.purinvcode and
										pl.posted='Y' and
										pd.icode = item.icode
									
									
									UNION All
									
									select 	qty= -1 * ( sum(isnull(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty, 0))) 
									from prdetail pd ,prledger pl
									where pl.date<:ar_StartDate and
										pl.prinvcode=pd.prinvcode and
										pd.icode =item.icode
									
									
									UNION All
									
									select 	qty= - 1 *( sum(isnull(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty, 0)))
									from saledetail pd ,saleledger pl
									where  pl.date<:ar_StartDate and
										pl.saleinvcode=pd.saleinvcode and
										pd.due is Null and
										pd.icode =item.icode
									
									UNION ALL
								
									select 	qty= - 1 *( sum(isnull(pd.duesatisfyqty, 0)))
									from duesatisfydetail pd ,duesatisfyheader pl
									where pl.duesatisfydate<:ar_StartDate   and
										pl.duesatisfycode=pd.duesatisfycode and
										pd.icode =item.icode
						
									UNION All
									
									select 	qty=( sum(isnull(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty, 0)))
									from srdetail pd ,srledger pl
									where  pl.postdate<:ar_StartDate and
										pl.srinvcode=pd.srinvcode and
										pd.icode =item.icode
												
									UNION ALL
								
									select 	qty= ISNULL(sum(Case when pl.adjcatcode=1 
													then    pd.looseqty 
													ELSE    (-1) * pd.looseqty
													END ),0)
											from adjdetail pd ,adjheader pl
											where pl.date<:ar_StartDate  and
											 pl.adjcode=pd.adjcode and
											 pd.icode  = item.icode
												
									UNION ALL
								
									select 	qty= -1 * ISNULL(sum(pd.qty),0)
									from issuedetail pd, issueheader pl
									where  pl.date<:ar_StartDate and
										pl.issueinvcode=pd.issueinvcode and
										pd.icode  =item.icode
												
									UNION ALL
								
									select 	qty= ISNULL(sum(pd.qty),0)
									from receiptdetail pd, receiptheader pl
									where  pl.postdate<:ar_StartDate and
										pl.posted='Y' and
										pl.receiptinvcode=pd.receiptinvcode and
										pd.icode  =item.icode
									
									) AS B)
			from item
			where item.icatcode in (:ar_catcode) and item.active=1
	


	) AS A,
item I

WHERE I.icatcode in (:ar_catcode) and I.icode=A.icode
GROUP BY I.icode,
	I.purprice,
	I.saleprice,
	I.packunits,
	I.avgprice
ORDER BY 
	Categoryname,
	MAX(I.name)
